items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Oliver' only in the phrase 'Oliver and I get Perez', which appears to be a transcription error or a reference to a specific horn model/brand (likely King Oliver or a horn type) rather than a personal relationship with the musician Oliver. No further context links the intervi

ctx.x: A lot of the old timers over there used Kahn in the old days.
Oliver and I get Perez. You get a better reception on the outside.

Well, we don't want to bother you anymore, but unless there's something else you can think about, some of the other trumpet players you'd want to add about, anything about Manuel Perez or any of the others that you were especially close to?
